passages.quote:
The Cabinet Secretary, Sir Jeremy Heywood, has given guidance to civil servants and special advisers ahead of the EU referendum.

This guidance applies from 27 May to 23 June 2016, the statutory 28-day pre-referendum period that is often referred to as ‘purdah’.

This replaces the guidance that applied for the period up to and including 26 May, which is provided for reference. It followed on from the Prime Minister’s letter to ministers.
